title: Custom 3D Totem
description: Easily replace the default Totem of Undying with your own custom 3D model!
body:
# 🌟 Custom 3D Totem

Bored of the flat, default Totem of Undying? This resource pack allows you to fully customize and replace the vanilla totem with a high-quality, custom 3D model of your choice! 

### ✨ Features
* **Fully Custom 3D Model:** Replaces the standard 2D totem item texture with an immersive 3D object.
* **Easy to Customize:** Perfect for adding your own custom skins, character models, or unique items as your personal savior.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Works smoothly on multiplayer servers and single-player worlds without needing any complex mods.

### 🛠️ How to use
1. Download the resource pack and add it to your `.minecraft/resourcepacks` folder.
2. Activate it in-game from your Resource Packs menu.
3. Enjoy your brand new custom 3D Totem of Undying!

---
*Note: Make sure this pack stays at the top of your resource pack list to overwrite any default textures.*
